source_refs.note: Book p. 231: 12.3.1 One-Sided Limits: opening paragraph, '(i) The Left Hand Limit', 'The Right Hand Limit' (no '(ii)' printed) and the Note side box on the rules for one-sided limits.

blocks.text: Pichle section mein jab hum \(\lim_{x \to c} f(x)\) nikaalte the to \(x\) ko \(c\) ke qareeb dono taraf se ek saath le jate the. Aaj hum yeh dekhenge ke agar sirf ek taraf se qareeb jayein to kya hota hai. Isi ko one-sided limit (ek taraf ki limit) kehte hain, aur aage continuity ka poora concept isi par khara hai.

Kitab kehti hai: \(\lim_{x \to c} f(x)\) ki definition mein humne \(x\) ko aise open interval (khula waqfa) mein rakha tha jis mein \(c\) shamil ho, yani humne \(c\) ke dono taraf \(f\) ka rawaiya (behaviour) dekha. Lekin kuch cases mein one sided limits ko alag alag dekhna zaroori hota hai, yani left hand limit (baayen taraf ki limit) aur right hand limit (daayen taraf ki limit).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Sirf ek taraf kyun dekhein? Teen aam soorat-e-haal hain:
1. Function \(c\) ke dono taraf alag alag formulas se diya gaya ho (isay piecewise function, yani tukdon wala function kehte hain), maslan \(f(x) = 2x + 1\) jab \(x \le 2\) aur \(7 - x\) jab \(x > 2\). Ab har taraf ka hisaab us taraf ke apne formula se hoga.
2. Function dono taraf mukhtalif rawaiya rakhta ho, maslan \(\frac{|x|}{x}\) har \(x < 0\) ke liye \(-1\) hai aur har \(x > 0\) ke liye \(1\).
3. Function sirf ek taraf exist karta ho, maslan \(\sqrt{x}\) zero ke qareeb sirf \(x \ge 0\) par defined hai; negative ka square root real nahin hota. Yahan to sirf right se hi aa sakte hain.

\(\lim_{x \to c^{-}} f(x) = L\) ko yun parhte hain: "limit of \(f(x)\) is equal to \(L\) as \(x\) approaches \(c\) from the left". Matlab: jab \(x\), \(c\) ke bohat qareeb ho lekin \(c\) se chhota ho, to \(f(x)\) ki value ko \(L\) ke jitna chahein utna qareeb kiya ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: \(c^{-}\) mein jo chhota sa minus sign hai woh negative number nahin hai! Yeh sirf direction batata hai: "left se", yani \(c\) se chhoti values ke raaste. Maslan \(c = 3\) ho to \(x\) yeh values leta hai: \(2.9, 2.99, 2.999, \dots\) Yeh 3 ke qareeb se qareeb tar hota jata hai magar 3 tak pohanchta nahin. Number line par socheein to aap 3 ki taraf baayen se chal kar aa rahe hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Ek aasaan misaal se samjhiye: ek seedhi sarak par ek pul (bridge) hai jo \(c\) kilometre par hai. Ek gaari pul ki taraf peeche se (left se) aa rahi hai, doosri gaari aage se (right se). Left hand limit poochti hai: "peeche se aane wali gaari jab pul ke bilkul qareeb pohanchti hai to us ki unchai (height) kya hoti hai?" Agar pul ke dono kinare ek hi level par hon to dono gaariyan ek hi height par pohanchengi; agar ek kinara ooncha aur doosra neecha ho (jaise toota hua pul) to dono ke jawab alag honge. Bas yahi one-sided limits ka khel hai.

\(\lim_{x \to c^{+}} f(x) = M\) ko yun parhte hain: "limit of \(f(x)\) is equal to \(M\) as \(x\) approaches \(c\) from the right". Matlab: jab \(x\), \(c\) ke bohat qareeb ho lekin \(c\) se bara ho, to \(f(x)\) ki value ko \(M\) ke jitna chahein utna qareeb kiya ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Kitab left hand limit par to "(i)" likhti hai magar The Right Hand Limit se pehle "(ii)" nahin likhti. Pareshan na hon: right hand limit bas dono one-sided limits mein se doosri hai.
Yahan \(c^{+}\) ka matlab hai "right se": \(c = 3\) ho to \(x = 3.1, 3.01, 3.001, \dots\) Yani aap 3 ki taraf daayen se, bari values se chal kar aa rahe hain.

blocks.title: Note
blocks.text: Kitab ka note: left hand aur right hand limits nikaalne ke rules bilkul wahi hain jo humne pichle section mein limits nikaalne ke liye parhe the. Yani koi naya formula yaad nahin karna; sirf yeh dekhna hai ke kis taraf se aa rahe hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Amal mein one-sided limit kaise nikaalein? Teen qadam yaad kar lijiye:
1. Pehle decide karein ke aap kis taraf hain: \(c^{-}\) ho to \(x < c\), \(c^{+}\) ho to \(x > c\).
2. Phir \(f\) ka woh formula chunein jo us taraf valid hai. Piecewise function mein yahi sab se ahem qadam hai.
3. Ab us formula ki limit aam rules se nikaalein: \(x\) ki jagah \(c\) rakhein; agar \(\frac{0}{0}\) aaye to pehle factorise kar ke simplify karein.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh kitab ki misaal nahin, samajhne ke liye hamari taraf se hai. \(f(x) = \frac{|x|}{x}\) ki one-sided limits \(c = 0\) par nikaaliye.
Left side: \(x < 0\) ho to \(|x| = -x\) (kyun ke modulus negative number ko positive bana deta hai, maslan \(|-5| = 5 = -(-5)\)). Is liye \(f(x) = \frac{-x}{x} = -1\), aur \(\lim_{x \to 0^{-}} f(x) = -1\).
Right side: \(x > 0\) ho to \(|x| = x\), is liye \(f(x) = \frac{x}{x} = 1\), aur \(\lim_{x \to 0^{+}} f(x) = 1\).
Dekha? Baayen se aayein to jawab \(-1\), daayen se aayein to \(1\). Dono one-sided limits mukhtalif hain. Is ka kya natija nikalta hai, yeh agle sabaq 12.3.2 mein dekhenge.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: \(f(x) = \sqrt{x}\) ki \(c = 0\) par left hand limit kyun nahin nikaal sakte? (Ishara: \(x\) ko 0 se chhota, yani negative lein to \(\sqrt{x}\) real number hi nahin rehta.) Aur right hand limit kya hai? Jawab: \(\lim_{x \to 0^{+}} \sqrt{x} = 0\).

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Paper mein hamesha subscript mein side likhiye (\(x \to 2^{-}\) ya \(x \to 2^{+}\)) aur saath likhiye ke kaun sa formula use kiya, maslan "for \(x < 2\), \(f(x) = 2x + 1\)". Examiner sahi tukda (piece) chunne ke marks deta hai, aur yeh ek line aap ko ghalti se bhi bachati hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Left hand limit \(\lim_{x \to c^{-}} f(x)\): \(x\), \(c\) se chhoti values ke zariye \(c\) ke qareeb aata hai.
2. Right hand limit \(\lim_{x \to c^{+}} f(x)\): \(x\), \(c\) se bari values ke zariye \(c\) ke qareeb aata hai.
3. Rules wahi purane hain; sirf side, aur us ki wajah se formula, badalta hai.
4. Khud \(f(c)\) ki value kisi bhi one-sided limit mein hissa nahin leti; limit sirf qareeb ki values dekhti hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(c^{-}\) ko "negative \(c\)" samajh lena: \(x \to 2^{-}\) ka matlab hai \(x\) neeche se \(+2\) ki taraf ja raha hai, \(-2\) ki taraf nahin.
2. Piecewise function ka ghalat tukda use karna: \(x \to 2^{+}\) ke liye woh formula lein jo \(x > 2\) ke liye likha hai, chahe \(x \le 2\) wala formula pehle likha ho.
3. One-sided limit ki jagah \(f(c)\) likh dena; dono alag ho sakte hain. Pehle side dekhiye, phir formula, phir limit.
